title: Platinum Account at a glance
summary: This document summarizes the Platinum Account: APY is 6.5%, you must maintain a $50,000 minimum balance to keep Platinum benefits, and extended FDIC insurance is available through partner banks (if eligible). If you opt in to extended insurance, enrollment and allocations are coordinated for you.
